paragraphs: I'm a Frontend & Full Stack Developer focused on building responsive, performant, and maintainable web applications. My work spans modern frontend architecture, reusable UI components, API integration, and backend development.

I work with React, Next.js, and TypeScript to build structured user interfaces, and use Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB to develop backend services and data-driven features. My projects include admin dashboards, e-commerce functionality, authentication flows, and interactive web experiences.
I prioritize clean architecture, usability, performance, and maintainability—making technical decisions that support both the user experience and the long-term reliability of an application.
